en.title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 Launches September 29: Here's When You Can Play
en.summary: Get ready to dive back into the blocky dungeons! Minecraft Dungeons 2 is officially launching soon, bringing new adventures and challenges to players worldwide. Here's exactly when you can expect to join the fray.
en.body:
The wait is almost over for fans eager to return to the action-RPG spin-off of the beloved sandbox phenomenon. **Minecraft Dungeons 2** has a confirmed release date of Tuesday, September 29, 2026. Developed once again by **Mojang Studios** in collaboration with **Double Eleven**, this sequel promises to expand on the core gameplay that charmed players with its accessible yet engaging combat and loot-driven progression.

Players can expect to embark on new quests across the Overworld, facing down a fresh wave of evil that threatens to plunge the world into chaos. The game encourages players to hone their builds by carefully selecting weapons, armor, and powerful artifacts. While solo adventures are certainly an option, **Minecraft Dungeons 2** fully embraces its cooperative spirit, allowing up to four players to team up in the same lobby for shared dungeon-crawling fun. The game is set to launch on **Xbox Series X & S, PS5, Switch 1 & 2, Steam, and PC**, with **Xbox Game Pass** Ultimate subscribers gaining access on day one.

## Countdown to Chaos

The official launch is set for September 29, 2026, with initial global release times being staggered. For those in North America, the adventure begins at 1:00 AM PT / 4:00 AM EDT. European players can expect to jump in around 10:00 PM CEST. These times are based on the official announcements, and while no significant changes are anticipated this close to launch, any updates will be duly noted. The anticipation has been building, especially following an alternate reality game that began promoting the sequel back in March 2026, culminating in a final video just days before the official release.

## What's New for Dungeon Delvers

While specific new features beyond an expanded Overworld and new evil threats have not been fully detailed, the franchise's history suggests a focus on refining the existing formula. Expect new enemy types, more challenging boss encounters, and a plethora of new gear to discover. The community has been actively discussing potential additions, from new enchantment combinations to entirely novel weapon classes. The success of the original **Minecraft Dungeons** has set a high bar, and fans are hopeful that **Minecraft Dungeons 2** will deliver an even more robust and rewarding experience, continuing the legacy of making dungeon crawling accessible and fun for everyone.

## What's Next

With the release date firmly set for September 29, 2026, the focus now shifts to the launch itself. Players can wishlist the game on their preferred platforms to receive notifications. The **Xbox Game Pass** announcement also ensures a significant player base will be ready to explore from day one, making it a prime time for cooperative adventures.

content_raw: Minecraft Dungeons 2 is coming soon to gamers worldwide, and you won’t have to wait long to begin your adventure. Developed by Mojang Studios and Double Eleven, this is set to be the next chapter of the franchise, and it includes plenty of new features to talk about. However, let’s first check out when the game goes live. Pick up your weapon, prepare your build and then power your way through hordes of enemies. There’s a new chapter in the Minecraft Dungeons saga that you get to enjoy across the Overworld. Your objective is to get the best possible build by picking across weapons, armors, and artifacts. While you can play the game on your own, Minecraft Dungeons 2 supports co-op adventure with up to four people in the same lobby.
